Root cause: use-market-ws.ts auto-reconnected but only paused on null token — no AppState handling, so the live quote stream stayed open behind the lock screen, waking JS+radio on every tick during market hours. Fix: appActive flag from an AppState listener gates the connect effect (!token || !appActive); background → existing cleanup closes socket + clears timer, foreground → fresh reconnect. tsc green, no new lint. Dev-build heat (React Compiler + Fast Refresh) is separate — true battery verdict needs a release build.

cards.title: Mobile: auto-save chat history + sync
cards.notes: 2026-07-07. Founder: auto-save all + browse list. Stream switched temporary→saved (use-chat creates session on first turn, serv persists via finalize_chat_turn, temporary fallback if create fails); loadSession() maps stored parts→transcript; chat-history.tsx overlay (list pinned-first, tap-load, swipe-delete, pin) on serv's existing /api/chat/sessions* API. tsc+lint clean. PENDING on-device test. Follow-up: legacy Swipeable import is deprecated in RNGH 2.31 (works, warns) → ReanimatedSwipeable.

cards.title: Mobile chat renders raw tool-call XML (serv prompt fix)
cards.notes: Founder hit live 2026-07-07: assistant bubble printed <function_calls> XML instead of an answer. SERV-side: ai/chat/mobile_agent.py:150 final complete() reuses the full agentic _system_prompt() (tool catalog + 'call the tools') but has no native tool-parsing → model emits tool XML as text → streams to client as content. Fix: give the final synthesis call a tools-free prompt, OR migrate mobile onto ai/chat/loop.py (unified brain). Client guard shipped (strip-tool-markup.ts) is damage-control only. Full writeup: References/MAC_REPLY_2026-07-08.md.

cards.title: Migrate mobile chat onto unified loop.py brain (iterative tool-calling)
cards.notes: FOUNDER-FLAGGED 2026-07-07. Founder saw web chain ~12 tool calls into a full report while mobile punted ('no tool results… I'll run scans next turn') — mobile is on single-pass plan_tools (ai/chat/mobile_agent.py), NOT iterative native tool-calling. Migrate POST /api/chat/stream onto ai/chat/loop.py, ENCODING iteration into the unchanged 6-event mobile SSE contract (do NOT point at web /api/chat = AI-SDK UIMessageStream, client can't parse). Preserve: propose_order→create_phone_proposal (phone biometric approve), create_rule gate, saved-mode persistence. Real token streaming falls out for free. Full brief: References/MAC_TO_SERV_2026-07-08_mobile-chat-brain.md. Client rendering (markdown bubbles + tool-call timeline) shipping in parallel Mac-side.
